entities.summary: Guillaume Emmanuel "Guy-Manuel" de Homem-Christo is a French musician and record producer. He is known as one half of the former French house music duo Daft Punk, along with Thomas Bangalter. He has produced several works from his now-defunct record label Crydamoure with label co-owner Éric Chedeville.
